原: What business sector in the Middle East? / Are we talking about here?
疑为: What business sector in the Middle East are we talking about here?
理由: 一个问句被问号切成两句；26、27 应为一句，译文按一句的意思分两半

原: … for the New Deal to exclude the Middle East?
疑为: … for the new deal to exclude the Middle East?
理由: 指对话里的新协议，不是罗斯福“新政”，不应大写；译为“新协议”

原: Carlos Montiero … Arna Ostrup of Novo Nordisk Foundation … august 14 …
疑为: Carlos Monteiro … Arne Astrup of Novo Nordisk Foundation … August 14 …
理由: 两位学者真实姓名为 Carlos Monteiro、Arne Astrup（第 88 句又写作 Montero）；月份未大写；译名按真名译为卡洛斯·蒙泰罗、阿尔内·阿斯特鲁普

原: In a 2015 study, which examined how … resources. / Ravi Mehta at the University of Illinois and Mengju at Johns Hopkins University found that …
疑为: In a 2015 study, which examined how …, Ravi Mehta at the University of Illinois and Meng Zhu at Johns Hopkins University found that …
理由: 主句被句点切开，99、100 应为一句；Mengju 疑为 Meng Zhu（该研究合作者，约翰斯·霍普金斯大学），译为朱萌

原: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard, Question 12: …
疑为: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard. / Question 12: …
理由: 念题套话与第 12 题连成一句，按两句译

原: But we do have a. / Personal strategy, and because it is learned, …
疑为: But we do have a personal strategy, and because it is learned, …
理由: 一句从冠词 a 后被句点切断；120、121 应为一句

原: … gives you a prospective model on the future.
疑为: … gives you a predictive model of the future.”
理由: 第 158 句开始的引语没有后引号，译文在此句末补上”；prospective 疑为 predictive，按“预测未来的模型”译

原: … and only by realizing we are. / Part of a bigger entity, can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems?
疑为: … and only by realizing we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems.
理由: 一句从 we are 后被句点切断；185、186 应为一句，且是陈述句，不是问句
